page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; below it a table of contents in two columns of numbered entries with a bracketed "De" group label and page references at right; a centred section heading "LOCUS XII." in italic capitals; then a title heading in capitals with a second line; a second numbered list with the same layout; signature mark and catchword at the foot. Faint show-through text from the reverse page appears in the background and is not transcribed.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is faint in the background and not transcribed. The "De" labels and the bracket marks are the printed grouping of the list; the first list's group label is set once beside the whole group. Entries marked "Pascha te." are read as printed with a possible misreading of "Pascha te" (Pasche?) at line IX; doubtful. The entry "Thef. 1-4" is italic in the original.
